_doc: Which version folder of each rebuildable data product the code reads: data/<kind>/<version>/. Rebuilds ALWAYS write a NEW version (v2, v3 …) and switch here only after A/B + demo_check; the versions in data/DEMO_MANIFEST.json (demo-final) are never modified or deleted. The chip index is versioned by its INDEX_VERSION folder under data/precompute/.
